rationale.conceptual: The method is an established but non-trivial DFT approach (FPLAPW, GGA+SOC+SP) requiring careful implementation of spin-orbit coupling, basis set selection, equation-of-state fitting, and interpretation of projected DOS to extract gap widths. It involves multiple interacting components and domain-specific knowledge, but no novel algorithm derivation.
rationale.execution: The pipeline comprises 5 steps: structure generation, volume-scan DFT runs with equation-of-state fitting, self-consistent DOS calculations, gap extraction, and formation heat computation. Managing numerous calculations (11 systems, multiple volumes) and dependencies between steps requires orchestration, but the tooling (Elk) is standard and data volumes are small.

The multi-stage pipeline (5 steps) with dependencies and use of specialized open-source code (Elk) presents moderate orchestration difficulty.
